mapper.select: SELECT PR.PRODUCTPN AS product, PR.PANELPCS AS panelPcs, PR.WIPQTY AS wipQty, pr.lotname AS lotCode, pr.status AS status, CASE WHEN s2.stepid IS NULL OR UPPER(s2.STEPNAME) LIKE '%TRACKIN' THEN s1.description ELSE s2.description END AS lotSite FROM wip w LEFT JOIN prp_lot pr ON pr.lotname = w.sn LEFT JOIN step s1 ON s1.stepid = w.currentstepid LEFT JOIN vprocessstep vp ON vp.PROCESSID = pr.processid AND vp.STEPID = s1.stepid AND VP.NODETYPE = 'PASS' LEFT JOIN step s2 ON vp.NEXTSTEPID = s2.stepid WHERE W.SN = #{lotCode} AND ROWNUM=1
